title: Wales's most capped players
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Wales in full internationals, to the end of the 2026 World Cup.

notes.Joe Ledley: Joe Ledley and Joe Allen are joint 10th with 77; either fills it.
notes.Joe Allen: Joe Allen and Joe Ledley are joint 10th with 77; either fills it.
notes.Dean Saunders: Dean Saunders is 12th with 75, just outside.
notes.Harry Wilson: Harry Wilson had 69 at the end of the 2026 World Cup.
notes.Ben Davies: Ben Davies had 100 caps at the end of the 2026 World Cup; caps since then don't count here.

checks: Wikipedia's records page and list of Wales internationals as they stood in June 2026 (updated to 6 June 2026, Wales's last match before the cut-off), RSSSF and Transfermarkt's match data (Davies 100 at the cut-off, 104 now) agree. Ashley Williams is 86 on Wikipedia and RSSSF, 87 on Transfermarkt; 86 is used (6th or 7th either way). Ledley and Allen share 10th on 77.
